cause: The workflow constructs the shipment request with reservation_id taken from input order_id instead of from the reservation result. Inventory returns reservation_id as the string reservation: followed by order_id, while the workflow requires the shipment identifier to equal the reservation identifier, so the comparison fails and the workflow explicitly fails with reservation-routing-mismatch.
evidence: The read main workflow source, hash sha256:651647b706da7462ea20a14aabd8063a02ec2cc54262f18672e5b734c541128d, contains (get input "order_id") in shipment-source and compares the shipment and reservation identifiers.
The read inventory source, hash sha256:d78ebd198524b8f66bd73945e1f10db561d307f79afc98ead1e539c0b50f7cc2, returns reservation_id as (str "reservation:" (get request "order_id")).
The read shipping source, hash sha256:d0c4122b5cb220d107478533fb4b491f9341e7b475feac5871da110ac2fb5b19, preserves the supplied reservation_id in its result.
The read explicit failure value is {"kind" "reservation-routing-mismatch"}, matching the mismatch branch in main.
